shared_elements: dense low-relief carving covering a tall vertical panel
rows/registers of motifs read down the surface
repeated identical elements aligned in a horizontal row
band of small repeated triangular/zigzag pattern
justification: Both are tall vertical surfaces covered with low-relief motifs organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both include profile animal heads, a bird-like creature and a band of repeated small triangular marks. But A consists of abstract compartmentalised sign-blocks in strict paired columns of highly stylised faces and geometric infill, while B shows large free-standing zoomorphic figures (quadruped, standing bird, row of hooded creatures) in an open pictorial field, so the actual subject matter and drawing conventions differ fundamentally.
